title: PHP Web Developer
description:
**PHP Developer – Custom Web Applications & Business Systems**

**Company:** Code With Agni  
**Website:** https://www.codewithagni.live  
**Experience:** 2–3 Years  
**Salary:** ₹20,000 – ₹25,000 per month  
**Job Type:** Full-Time  
**Work Location:** Hybrid  
**Department:** Software Development

**About Code With Agni**

**Code With Agni** is a web development and software solutions company focused on building custom web applications, business management systems, SaaS platforms, e-commerce solutions, and workflow automation systems.

We work on projects involving CRM, ERP, inventory management, quotation and pricing systems, booking platforms, payment integrations, third-party APIs, and other business-specific software solutions.

We are looking for a skilled and motivated PHP Developer with 2–3 years of practical experience who can develop, maintain, and improve web applications while contributing to the complete software development lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop, maintain, and enhance web applications using **Core PHP, CodeIgniter, and Laravel**.
* Build custom business applications, including **CRM, ERP, inventory management, quotation systems, order management, and administrative dashboards**.
* Write **clean, reusable, secure, and maintainable** code following established coding standards.
* Design, develop, and optimize **MySQL** databases, including tables, relationships, indexes, queries, and transactions.
* Implement business logic, complex calculations, pricing rules, **workflow automation,** and role-based access control.
* Develop responsive and user-friendly interfaces using HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, JavaScript, jQuery, and AJAX.
* Customize and maintain **WordPress** websites, themes, plugins, and CMS-based solutions.
* Work with **Shopify** and other e-commerce platforms when required.
* Develop and integrate REST APIs, third-party services, payment gateways, webhooks, and notification systems.
* Debug existing applications, identify performance issues, fix bugs, and implement new features without disrupting existing functionality.
* Use **Git and GitHub** for version control and collaborative development.
* Test features, validate edge cases, and ensure application reliability, security, and performance.
* Assist with application deployment, server configuration, database migrations, and production troubleshooting.
* Collaborate on project requirements, technical implementation, code reviews, and delivery timelines.

Required Technical Skills

**Backend Development**

* Strong understanding of **Core PHP** and object-oriented programming (**OOP**).
* Practical experience with **CodeIgniter and/or Laravel**.
* Good understanding of **MVC architecture, authentication, sessions, validation, and reusable application components.**
* Ability to implement complex business logic and multi-step workflows.

**Database Management**

* Strong knowledge of MySQL and relational database design.
* Experience with joins, indexes, constraints, transactions, and query optimization.
* Ability to design efficient database structures for real-world business applications.

**Frontend Development**

* Proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, and responsive web design.
* Working knowledge of JavaScript, jQuery, and AJAX.
* Ability to convert UI designs or requirements into functional web interfaces.

**Development Tools and Integration**

* Experience with Git and GitHub.
* Understanding of **REST APIs, JSON, HTTP methods, and third-party integrations**.
* Knowledge of debugging, error handling, application security, and testing.

Preferred Qualifications

The following skills will be considered an advantage:

* Experience developing or maintaining **CRM, ERP, SaaS, inventory, billing, booking, or other business management systems**.
* **WordPress** theme and plugin development or customization.
* Shopify theme **customization and e-commerce development**.
* Experience integrating **payment gateways, email services, SMS/WhatsApp notifications, or external business** platforms.
* Familiarity with **cron jobs, webhooks, scheduled tasks, and workflow automation tools such as n8n**.
* Basic knowledge of **Linux servers, Apache/Nginx, Docker, and application deployment**.
* Experience working with **AI APIs, OCR services, document processing**, or other automation-related integrations.
* Familiarity with Laravel migrations, **Eloquent ORM, PHPUnit, or equivalent framework** tools.

What We Are Looking For

* A developer who understands how to translate business requirements into functional software.
* Someone who can independently handle assigned modules and take ownership of deliverables.
* Strong logical thinking and problem-solving abilities.
* Attention to detail, especially when working with calculations, database relationships, and business workflows.
* Willingness to learn new technologies and adapt to different project requirements.
* Ability to work with existing codebases, understand unfamiliar systems, and improve them systematically.
* **Good communication skills, accountability, and a commitment to meeting deadlines.**

Compensation

**Monthly Salary: ₹20,000 – ₹25,000**, depending on technical proficiency, practical experience, and the ability to work independently.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can share their updated resume along with the following details:

* Total PHP development experience.
* Experience with CodeIgniter and Laravel.
* Links to previous projects, GitHub repositories, or portfolio, if available.
* Experience developing CRM, ERP, SaaS, or other custom business applications.
* Current location and notice period.
* Expected salary.

**Apply through:** info@codewithagni.live

Website: https://www.codewithagni.live

*Candidates may be asked to complete a short technical assessment as part of the selection process.*

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Work from home

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Kolkata, West Bengal

title: Custom Software Engineering Lead
description:
**Project Role :** Custom Software Engineering Lead  
**Project Role Description :** Own the technical direction and architecture of custom software solutions, leading teams through design and delivery. Set development standards and ensure code quality, scalability, and performance aligned to business objectives.
  
**Must have skills :** AWS CloudFormation  
**Good to have skills :** AWS AI Services  
Minimum **12** year(s) of experience is required  
**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  
  
Summary:
  
As a Custom Software Engineering Lead, a typical day involves steering the technical vision and architectural framework for bespoke software projects. This role requires guiding teams through the entire lifecycle of design and implementation, ensuring that development practices meet high standards. The position demands continuous oversight to maintain code quality, scalability, and system performance, all while aligning with the strategic goals of the organization. Collaboration with various stakeholders to synchronize efforts and deliver robust software solutions is a key aspect of daily activities.  
  
Roles & Responsibilities:
  

* Expected to be an SME, collaborate and manage the team to perform.
* Responsible for team decisions.
* Engage with multiple teams and contribute on key decisions.
* Expected to provide solutions to problems that apply across multiple teams.
* Lead the establishment and enforcement of development standards to ensure consistency and quality across projects.
* Facilitate effective communication and coordination among cross-functional teams to drive project success.
* Mentor and support junior team members to foster professional growth and enhance team capabilities.

  
Professional & Technical Skills:
  

* Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in AWS CloudFormation.
* Good To Have Skills: Experience with AWS AI Services.
* Strong knowledge of cloud infrastructure design and deployment using infrastructure as code principles.
* Ability to optimize cloud resources for performance, cost, and security.
* Experience in troubleshooting and resolving complex cloud architecture issues.
* Familiarity with automation tools and continuous integration/continuous deployment pipelines.

  
Additional Information:
  

* The candidate should have minimum 12 years of experience in AWS CloudFormation.
* This position is based at our Kolkata office.
* A 15 years full time education is required.

  
15 years full time education

title: WooCommerce & Laravel Developer (API Integration)
description:
Job Description: WooCommerce & Laravel Developer (API Integration)

**Company:** Webtechnomind IT Solutions Pvt. Ltd.  
**Job Title:** WooCommerce & Laravel Developer  
**Department:** Software Development  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Work Mode:** Work From Office  
**Location:** Newtown, Kolkata, West Bengal, India  
**Experience:** 5-8 Years

About Webtechnomind

Webtechnomind IT Solutions Pvt. Ltd. is a full-service IT solutions company specializing in web development, mobile application development, eCommerce solutions, digital marketing, and custom software development. We help businesses build scalable digital products through innovative technology and end-to-end development services.

We are looking for a skilled **WooCommerce & Laravel Developer** with strong experience in API integration, custom plugin development, and backend development to join our growing development team.

Key Responsibilities1. WooCommerce Development

* Develop, customize, and maintain WooCommerce-based eCommerce websites.
* Build custom WooCommerce plugins, themes, hooks, and functionalities.
* Customize product pages, checkout flows, payment gateways, shipping methods, and order management systems.
* Integrate third-party services, payment gateways, shipping APIs, and inventory management systems.
* Optimize website speed, security, scalability, and performance.
* Troubleshoot and resolve WooCommerce-related technical issues.

2. Laravel Development

* Develop and maintain scalable web applications using Laravel.
* Build custom backend modules, business logic, admin panels, and database-driven applications.
* Design, develop, and maintain RESTful APIs for web and mobile applications.
* Work with MySQL databases, including database design, query optimization, and migrations.
* Implement authentication, authorization, validation, and secure data handling.
* Write clean, reusable, maintainable, and well-documented code.

3. API Integration & Development

* Develop and integrate REST APIs between WooCommerce, Laravel applications, and third-party platforms.
* Integrate payment gateways, CRM systems, ERP software, shipping providers, and external services.
* Handle API authentication, JSON/XML data exchange, error handling, and response validation.
* Implement webhooks and real-time data synchronization where required.
* Debug API issues and ensure reliable communication between multiple systems.

4. Collaboration & Maintenance

* Collaborate with UI/UX designers, frontend developers, project managers, and QA teams.
* Participate in code reviews, testing, debugging, and deployment.
* Maintain existing projects and resolve production issues.
* Follow coding standards, version control practices, and development best practices.
* Provide technical documentation and regular project updates.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* 5-8 years of experience in PHP development.
* Strong hands-on experience with Laravel framework.
* Practical experience developing and customizing WooCommerce websites.
* Good knowledge of WordPress architecture, hooks, filters, and plugin development.
* Strong experience developing and integrating REST APIs.
* Proficiency in PHP, MySQL, JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
* Experience with JSON, API authentication, webhooks, and third-party integrations.
* Understanding of MVC architecture, object-oriented programming, and database optimization.
* Familiarity with Git/GitHub and version control workflows.
* Knowledge of website security, performance optimization, and debugging.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple development tasks.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience integrating WooCommerce with external Laravel applications.
* Knowledge of payment gateway integrations such as Razorpay, Stripe, or PayPal.
* Experience with shipping, logistics, inventory, CRM, or ERP APIs.
* Familiarity with Postman, Linux servers, cPanel, or cloud hosting environments.
* Experience with frontend frameworks such as Vue.js or React.js.
* Understanding of deployment workflows and CI/CD practices.

What We Offer

* Opportunity to work on challenging eCommerce and custom software projects.
* Collaborative and growth-oriented working environment.
* Opportunities to learn new technologies and improve technical expertise.
* Exposure to real-world API integrations and scalable application development.
* Career growth opportunities based on performance and contribution.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can share their updated resume along with links to relevant projects or GitHub repositories.

Send your updated resume on hr@webtechnomind.com

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹35,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person
